title: The end-of-term question retrieves the clause that states the term

retrieval.note: Rank 2 → rank 1, and this one is the proof 14.1b is a fix rather than a change. The front-page chunk beat it outright, 0.358 to 0.454 — an uncitable chunk of parties and ID numbers winning a question about the lease term. It is no longer embedded, and the clause that states the term now wins its own question by 0.016 over §2.1–2.3 — narrower headroom than the rent case's 0.062, and still more than twice the 0.006 the embedder's own jitter can move a distance. Slice 12.2 measured this question at 3rd of 8 on the real lease, distance 0.428.
